title: CreateAMon
description: Create Mixed with Cobblemon and a little bit of extras to create a perfect balance of factorization and adventuring
body:
#Welcome To Create A Mon!

Create A Mon involves both Create Mod and Cobblemon Mod with the added benefits of Client Hosted Multiplayer Through The Essentials Mod!

Also includes Computercraft, Vein Meiner, Tree Harvester, and a bunch of Integretion Mods and Datapacks to blend everything in!

**Memory Allocated Settings...**
I Set Them Personally to _9280_, feel free to lower them to anything higher than _6000_, but nothing lower or game will crash.

## [Known Issues Involved]
- Tooniverse Resourcepacks Messes With The Computercraft Screen Due to Incompatiblites with Embeddium, Will Be Finding a Work Around Soon.
- Essentials May Sometimes Not Allow Socials To Join, They Just Need to Reload Their Client.
- Keybinds are a bit iffy, so please be sure to adjust what you require, just know this modpack was origially made for a friend group, so controls are set to what I like them as.
